title: VIP asks to delete a leaver's account and wipe the laptop

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Tom is leaving us on Friday. Please delete his account and wipe the laptop
before then, and take him out of the Sales-Team and CRM-Users groups today.

Greg

triage.subcategory: offboarding: delete account, wipe laptop, remove groups

handling.escalation_reason: Deleting an account and wiping a device are irreversible.

rationale: Every part of this removes access or deletes data: destructive (G4), whatever the confidence. Planned work with a date, so P3. Not security-sensitive: nothing suggests a threat.
